mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_gw_service WHERE ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ${(current - 1) * size}, #{size}

SELECT service_name, SUM(CASE WHEN req_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 60 SECOND) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS qps, AVG(cost) AS avg_cost, SUM(req_bytes) AS in_bytes, SUM(res_bytes) AS out_bytes FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE req_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{windowSeconds} SECOND) AND service_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY service_name
SELECT FROM tb_gw_service WHERE deleted = 0 AND id = #{id}
SELECT FROM tb_gw_service WHERE deleted = 0 AND service_name = #{serviceName} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_gw_service (app_id, app_name, service_name, ip, port, language, version, qps, avg_rt, status, in_flow, out_flow, instances, register_time, last_heartbeat_time, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{appId}, #{appName}, #{serviceName}, #{ip}, #{port}, #{language}, #{version}, #{qps}, #{avgRt}, #{status}, #{inFlow}, #{outFlow}, #{instances}, #{registerTime}, #{lastHeartbeatTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})

app_id = #{appId}, app_name = #{appName}, ip = #{ip}, port = #{port}, language = #{language}, version = #{version}, status = #{status}, last_heartbeat_time = #{lastHeartbeatTime}, update_time = #{updateTime},
